title: 3D Pistons
description: This resource pack enhances pistons with detailed 3D models to make redstone components look more mechanical and immersive while keeping the classic Minecraft style.
body:
3D Piston & Sticky Piston is a visual enhancement resource pack for Minecraft that upgrades the appearance of pistons by giving them detailed 3D models. Instead of the flat vanilla textures, pistons now have depth, improved mechanical details, and a more realistic structure.

![3D Pistons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3de425fd8d35d8db66c7ae44cc246a1c8f02c478.png)

This pack is perfect for players who enjoy building redstone machines, technical builds, and automation systems, because the upgraded piston design makes redstone components look more immersive and visually satisfying. The models are designed carefully so they still match Minecraft’s vanilla style, meaning they blend naturally with the default textures of the game.

Both the Piston and Sticky Piston have been redesigned with extra detail. The piston head, base, and moving parts feel more mechanical and realistic, while the sticky piston keeps its recognizable slime-covered head but now in a more detailed 3D form.

The pack focuses only on visual improvements, so gameplay mechanics remain completely unchanged. Pistons still function exactly the same as they do in vanilla Minecraft, making the pack safe to use in survival worlds, creative builds, and multiplayer servers.

Another important goal of this pack is performance optimization. The models are designed to stay lightweight so they do not negatively impact FPS or game performance. This makes the pack suitable for both low-end and high-end PCs.
